I've done the initial scan and hit a decisive finding that changes the plan — surfacing it before burning the window.

## What I found

**The intended primary data source — the migration's agent transcripts — is gone from this machine.**

- Claude Code retention is at the **default 30 days** (`cleanupPeriodDays` unset). Today is 2026-07-24.
- The migration work happened **~March–May 2026** under the old path `~/source/ohpc` (its Claude memory files — `feedback_tex_reference_only.md`, `project_3x_backport.md` "3.x Markdown Backport" — are dated 2026-05-07). That's **>30 days old → cleaned up**.
- The old checkout dirs are **deleted**: `~/source/ohpc`, `~/projects/ohpc-jetstream2` both gone.
- **No Time Machine / no backup / no preserved copies** found anywhere I can read.
- Only **2 transcripts survive** under the current `~/projects/hpc` path, both **July / warewulf** work (IB interface PR + this session) — **not** the migration.

So the tokens / tool-calls / chat-messages stats you specifically asked for **cannot be reconstructed from local transcripts** for the actual migration window.

## What *does* survive (solid, recoverable)

| Source | Detail |
|---|---|
| **Git history** (the anchor) | `docs/install` markdown-system: **17 commits (3.x)**, **30 commits (4.x)**; full docs history to 2014; milestone `4688732ca docs: delete latex documentation, everything is working with markdown`. Full diffs, timestamps, messages. |
| **Claude memory files** | 7 under old `source-ohpc/memory/` (MEMORY.md + migration-specific feedback/project notes), dated 2026-05-07 — the distilled state of the migration. |
| **The product itself** | `mkdoc.py` + Jinja2 templates + Makefile — the doc system the migration produced. |
| **2 July transcripts** | Usable as a *methodology sample* to prove out the stats pipeline, even though they're not the migration. |

Note: `ohpc-4.x` is currently on branch **`xcat-stateless`**, `ohpc-3.x` on **`3.x`** — I won't `git checkout` either without your say-so (per CLAUDE.md).

## The pivotal question

Everything downstream depends on whether those transcripts exist somewhere I can't see.

The hunt is settled — I'll stop looking. Verified reality:

## Findings (verified)

1. **Migration transcripts are gone and unrecoverable locally.** The work ran **Feb–May 2026**; retention is 30 days; the old checkout dirs (`~/source/ohpc`, `~/projects/ohpc-jetstream2`) are deleted; no Time Machine/backup; and the "some analysis" isn't stored in the `claude` workspace either (the 9 sessions that mention openhpc are NAIRR/CaRCC/jobs work that reference it in passing). If it exists, it's **off this machine**.

2. **But git + memory fully reconstruct the migration.** This is a genuinely rich dataset:
   - **Timeline & authorship**: 4.x POC landed **2026-02-05** (`077f4e19d`, Adrian Reber — your leveraged pre-work), cutover **2026-02-26** (`3707edeba`, you), LaTeX deleted **2026-04-19** (`cf392c942`). 3.x port **2026-04-29** (`22182c33f`, you), LaTeX deleted **2026-05-17** (`4688732ca`). Adrian is the dominant docs author (75 commits 4.x / 42 3.x since 2024-07); you're second (39/24).
   - **Before/after artifacts**: old `parse_doc.pl` (Perl/LaTeX) → new `parse_doc_md.py` + `mkdoc.py` (Python/Jinja2), full diffs in history.
   - **Memory files**: a very detailed `MEMORY.md` (design decisions, extraction markers, build system) + `project_3x_backport.md` (7-phase backport log) + `feedback_tex_reference_only.md`. These carry `originSessionId` pointers to the now-deleted sessions — provenance breadcrumbs.

## Proposed `papers/openhpc-markdown/` layout (info dump)

```
git/        full docs logs (3.x+4.x, txt+json), annotated milestones, milestone diffstats + patches
memory/     the surviving migration memory/*.md (verbatim, with originSessionId provenance)
product/    old parse_doc.pl vs new parse_doc_md.py/mkdoc.py + template tree inventory
transcripts/ sample/ (2 July + this session, junk-reduced) + SCHEMA.md (jq junk-reduction pipeline)
STATS.md    collected metrics (commits, files/lines converted, authors, timeline, LaTeX→MD deltas)
README.md   index + provenance + the transcript-gap note
```

## Decisions (answer by number — I'm starting the unambiguous git/memory/product ingest now regardless)

1. **Transcript-stats pipeline**: since real migration transcripts are gone, do you still want me to build the **jq junk-reduction schema + stats extractor** (tool-calls/messages/tokens) against the **2 surviving July transcripts** as a working methodology artifact — so it's ready if you find off-machine backups? (My rec: yes.)
2. **LaTeX era depth**: capture the **full pre-migration LaTeX system** (`docs/recipes/install/` at its last commit, `parse_doc.pl`) for a real before/after, or just the migration-window commits? (Rec: full — it's the "before" your paper needs.)
3. **Milestone diffs**: store **full patches** of the ~6 milestone commits (bigger, but complete) or just **diffstats** (compact)? (Rec: both — diffstat in STATS, full patches in `git/patches/`.)
